### Cursor fixes

- Your cursor picture is scaled to the size a cursor actually is. Roblox draws the texture at whatever size the file is, so a normal sized picture came out enormous. Pictures are now fitted to the size Roblox ships, keeping their proportions, and anything already smaller is left alone
- The cursor you chose is remembered when you close and reopen PhasmaStrap. It used to show nothing chosen on every start, even though Roblox still had your cursor
- The remove button works. It only appeared when PhasmaStrap thought a cursor was set, which after the bug above was never, so an applied cursor could not be taken off
